_comment: XuanTie xiaohui v2 SoC platform. INTC = aplic (AIA). CPUs on this SoC (c930/c925/c950) must have the Sstc ISA extension, because APLIC-based timer relies on stimecmp. Default DDR = 16G.

gmac._comment: GMAC 有三种模式(由 -gmac 选项 / CPU 自动决定):h100 = 默认 HAPS/H100 FPGA 网卡,socinit 用 init.mode_h100 写序列(net_mode=0);h100_v2 = c930/c925 自动切换的变体,socinit 用 init.mode_haps_v2 写序列(net_mode=1);pro = 独立 pro 网卡(-gmac pro),走 gmac_pro dtsi 模板、无此处 init 写序列。

net._comment: xiaohui_v2 PCIe: 与 NGF 同一配置 — enable rc1, rc0/rc1 ECAM 均声明(rc0 disabled), RP INTx APLIC 用 NGF rc1 的基址/标签(aplic_die0_pcie_rc1_rpN_m/s)。-nic pcie1|pcie1-rp<n> 选择 RC1 与 RP INTx; RP INTx 需 -intc aplic (RP APLIC MSI 挂 IMSIC)。缺省 pcie = rc1 okay, RP INTx 全 disabled。本平台无 gmac/RCiEP/IOMMU 声明, -iommu 与 gmac token 报错。

hsm._comment: HSM/power-management config: hsm.pmc drives the DTS pmc node (-pmc) and the socinit IPMC writes; hsm.pcu.boot_release drives the gdbinit reset/release sequence; hsm.pcu.version (+nodes, once registered) drives the PCU HSM DTS node.

pcu._comment: version = PCU HSM node generation switch (xuantie,pcu; xiaohui_v2 is v1-fixed). nodes (PCU address constants) is intentionally absent: the xiaohui_v2 PCU base/offsets differ from NGF and are pending hardware confirmation; without nodes the generator emits no PCU node (opensbi degrades to plain wfi).

boot_release._comment: Boot hart-release config (v2 = PCU, used by c925/c930/c950). reset_addrs = per-hart reset vector regs (set to $zsb_addr). release_addrs/release_value are the v2-only per-hart PCU release/config writes. Per-hart reset/config AND the global release (release_addr) are all layout-gated exactly like v1: only -layout-populated harts are active, the rest are commented out; the global release mask follows release_default (<=8 cores) / release_layout (>8 cores). NOTE: boot_release v1/v2 names the hart-release generation, distinct from both the -pmc DTS node (hsm.pmc) and the PCU HSM node version (hsm.pcu.version).

intc._comment: v2 is aplic-native (AIA): c930/c925/c950 select aplic by default. The plic sub-block is kept so `--intc plic` can be forced on v2 as well, mirroring v1. Sstc CPUs use stimecmp, so no aplic.mtimer node.

imsics_m.desc: IMSIC M-mode, base 属 PA48 地址范围 (size scales with core count)

imsics_s.desc: IMSIC S-mode, base 属 PA48 地址范围 (size scales with core count)

link_ip._comment: Interconnect/link IP by generation. ncore=NCore coherence bus (--bus ncore); xl200=XuanTie Link 200 (--bus stlk/stlk2); xl300=XuanTie Link 300 (--bus stlk3); xl100 reserved.

ncore._comment: Snoop/DVM regs derived as cluster_base + i*snoop_stride + snoop_offset (snoop) and cluster_base + dvm_offset (dvm). cluster0 has 4 snoop regs, cluster1 has 1.

xl300._comment: Per-cluster PMU + CBQRI + L3 cache derived from single-cluster prototypes: pmu/cbqri instance i lives at base + i*cluster_stride, irq at irq_base + i*irq_stride, cbqri cache phandle &l3_cache_<i>; the L3 cache node l3_cache_<i>/l3-cache-<i> is emitted per cluster from the l3_cache prototype and referenced by both cbqri and each core's next-level-cache. clusters = physical cluster count; each node's status is okay iff cluster i is populated by -layout. L3 cache is emitted ONLY on xl300 (--bus stlk3); non-xl300 RV64 builds carry no L3.

chosen._comment_initrd: initrd.end is a placeholder (0x0); the boot script backfills the real end address after it computes the rootfs size.

images_layout._comment: Boot image load addresses consumed by the gdb scripts (zsb.gdbinit + zsb_socinit.gdbinit).

optee._comment: OP-TEE boot: kernel/rootfs in the 0x8xxxxxxx window (matches optee DTS linux,initrd-start=0x84000000); bl31 secure monitor + tee-os secure.
